details.title: Do not use update instructions alone in the Dockerfile
alerts: Always combine 'apt-get update' with 'apt-get install|upgrade' : /bin/sh -c true apt-get update

details.title: Use COPY instead of ADD in Dockerfile
Do not store credential in environment variables/files
alerts: Suspicious filename found : app/id_rsa (You can suppress it with "-af id_rsa")
Suspicious ENV key found : DB_PASSWORD on /bin/sh -c #(nop) ENV DB_PASSWORD=******* GPG_KEY=abc123 PLAIN=value (You can suppress it with --accept-key)

details.title: Avoid sudo command
alerts: Avoid sudo in container : /bin/sh -c true sudo

details.title: Clear apt-get caches
alerts: Use 'rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists' after 'apt-get install|update' : /bin/sh -c true apt-get update

details.title: Create a user for the container
alerts: Last user should not be root

details.title: Avoid "apt-get dist-upgrade"
alerts: Avoid dist-upgrade in container : /bin/sh -c true apt-get dist-upgrade

details.title: Add HEALTHCHECK instruction to the container image
